web.landing.ussdCaption: The menu a farmer sees after dialling *384*7247#
web.landing.heroBody: Dial *384*7247#, or call and say what you have. Buyers across Ghana see your listing and make you an offer. When you accept, a driver on your road collects it.
web.landing.heroTry: Try the phone menu in your browser
web.landing.heroBuyers: Buying for a shop, a school kitchen or a processor? Create a buyer account to see what farmers have listed.
web.landing.heroAlt: Tomatoes, carrots, peppers and potatoes piled together
web.landing.step1: Ama grows maize near Garu. After harvest she dials *384*7247#, picks "Sell produce" and enters 10 bags, grade B.
web.landing.step2: Her listing is on the marketplace straight away, with her district and the quantity left.
web.landing.step3: A buyer in Kumasi places a bid. Ama gets an SMS and a voice call in Kusaal, and accepts from the same phone.
web.landing.step4: The buyer's money is held. A driver already working the Bawku road collects the bags, and they are graded at pickup.
web.landing.step5: Ama is paid to her mobile money number.
web.landing.howIntro: Here is one sale from start to finish. Ama is an example, but every step is what the app does today.
web.landing.whoFarmersText: List from a basic phone by menu or by voice. Offers come to you by SMS and a phone call, so you do not need data or a smartphone.
web.landing.whoBuyersText: See what is for sale up north before you travel, bid on a lot, or post what you need and get matched as new lots come in.
web.landing.whoDriversText: Tell us your routes and your vehicle. Loads that fit come to you first.
web.landing.why1: Most harvests in the Upper East are sold at the farm gate, to the first trader who arrives, at the trader's price. Buyers in Kumasi and Accra would often pay more, but they cannot see what is for sale up north.
web.landing.why2: F2M lets them see it. It is an early prototype: we are testing it with a small group of farmers, buyers and drivers, and payments are simulated for now.
web.landing.langBody: Menus, messages and voice calls work in the languages of the farmers who use F2M. The translations are made by machine for now, and native speakers are checking them line by line.
web.landing.prototype: Prototype. Payments are simulated and no real money moves.
